says: In next/, a single listed job whose take always failed (lacks_capability, not_allowed, or a journal entry that reads as bad_entry) was listed and taken again after every backoff, forever. Fixed in the same pull request: a take refused idle, ambiguous, not_allowed, lacks_capability or bad_input, or a bad_entry journal read, skips that job on the link until a list answers another rev; with nothing to take the client waits on jobs.wait. Passing refusals (rate_limited, unreachable, unavailable, storage) still retry after backoff.
proof: At c2ce4f498, the taking case (HandsMachine.ts:326-329) answered every failed take with relist(s, w.tries), and takeable (:274) picked from every once-listed job, so one such job was taken again each backoff (up to the Link CAP of 30 s).
cost: One call pair every 30 s per stuck job for the life of the link, each a ledger read of the key's whole target stream, and no wait on jobs.wait while it lasts.
